stable.label: ecosystem-sandbox-mobile-feeding-ci-pass
stable.note: The ecosystem remains the primary GENESIS experience. Fluid refinement, creature-rig math, and feeding-truth regression tests have GitHub Actions evidence. The newly wired phone UI and deployed route have not yet been exercised after this change, so user-facing LIVE_TESTED remains false.

active_experience.current_change: remove the legacy predator proximity-damage shortcut and replace the phone-first observer layout with hideable world-first controls
simulation_changes: legacy predator head-distance damage/grab path in handleInteractions is bypassed
predator tissue damage is now left to the existing V107 articulated jaw-node contact gate
corpse scavenging requires jaw-node overlap with a corpse body node before meat/energy transfer
2x-per-axis refined water field and existing creature-water coupling remain active
presentation_and_controls: phone default view hides the previous giant HUD/observer sheet
compact selected-creature strip and six-button touch dock
look mode hides all simulation UI except one restore button
truth chip explicitly reports JAW CONTACT / DIGESTION APPROX
approximations: V107 predator bite is a jaw-node to target-node distance/contact threshold, not tooth-shape penetration or collision-manifold biting
predator bite damage is localized to the nearest contacted body node but does not simulate material fracture/tearing mechanics
corpse scavenging is contact-gated but calories still move directly to energy; the ecosystem stack has no stomach/digestion pipeline
herbivore plant feeding and intelligent-creature plant gathering remain proximity-based resource transfer
V107 loose-gut scavenging still uses an older proximity/resource shortcut
the old body controller still applies authored direct body drive in several locomotion paths; movement is not a pure muscle-force biomechanics solver
limb mid-joints in the visual overhaul are derived bend points because the legacy limb model stores anchor + end-effector rather than explicit upper/lower limb bones
fluid_refinement is a conservative 2x subcell volume-relaxation approximation, not CFD/SPH/FLIP/PBF/MPM
biome labels and atmospheric layers are presentation/classification, not independent simulated biome agents

fluid_refinement.representation: 2D subcell water-volume field with pairwise conservative transfer and damped momentum proxy

physical_creature_v1.note: Preserved causal-body lab; not the primary user-facing ecosystem.

active_objective: Exercise the newly wired phone UI and feeding changes in iPhone Safari. If the controls behave correctly, the next simulation change is physical ingestion: mouth capture -> swallowed food mass -> stomach contents -> timed digestion, eliminating the remaining direct-calorie feeding shortcut for the selected vertical slice.
next_gate: A fresh iPhone/browser run must verify hide/show UI, drag, pinch, selection, inspector, and lack of runtime errors. Feeding CI_PASS does not prove the deployed browser behavior. The next causal simulation gate is stomach ingestion/digestion rather than more visual polish.
invariants: The ecosystem sandbox is the primary user-facing experience
A visual mouth animation is not proof of feeding
Predator proximity alone must not damage prey
Contact-gated scavenging must not be called digestion
Presentation layers must not be described as physics
No authored controller may be called learning
fluid_refinement must not be called CFD/SPH/FLIP/PBF/MPM
CI_PASS does not imply live deployment PASS
Unknown or unexercised runtime state remains UNKNOWN/NOT_TESTED
